messages:
sasha: Auditor pinged this morning asking for a tight evidence bundle showing an RBAC adjustment (service-account-inference-prod) and the related KMS decrypts around 2025-05-12 14:20 UTC. They want a one-page mapping + signed logs. Can we assemble by EOD?
paul_sec: I tracked the change: approval ticket SEC-1029, PR infra/iam#1320, commit d9f7a2. The RBAC diff reduced a role from roles/compute.viewer to a bespoke role with only kms.decrypt.
eng-zoe: I can grab the kube-audit event and the CI deploy log that executed the change. Will sanitize any request payloads. Snippet I'll include: 
```
{
  "kind": "Event",
  "verb": "create",
  "objectRef": {"resource": "rolebinding", "name": "sa-inference-prod-bind"},
  "user": "gitops-bot@redwood"
}
```
secbot: evidence-collector: start job ev-20250512-014; collecting artifacts: SEC-1029, commit/d9f7a2, kube-audit-snippet, kms-decrypt-export. Progress: 0/4.
auditor_lee: Clarifying Qs: 1) Need proof least-privilege was evaluated (matrix or checklist). 2) KMS decrypt entries must be exported with a checksum and detached signature. 3) Map to SOC2 CC-3.2 / CC-6.1 and ISO A.9.4.
paul_sec: Least-privilege assessment is in sec-reviews/rbac/2025-05-11-inference-sa.md (short checklist + table). I'll copy the assessment summary into the runbook.
ops-ryan: I'll export the KMS events for 2025-05-12 14:00-15:00 UTC and sign with ops@redwood.com. Command I will run: 
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND timestamp>="2025-05-12T14:00:00Z" AND timestamp<="2025-05-12T15:00:00Z"' --format=json > /tmp/kms-decrypt-20250512.json
gpg --local-user ops@redwood.com --output /tmp/kms-decrypt-20250512.json.sig --detach-sign /tmp/kms-decrypt-20250512.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-decrypt-20250512.json s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-05-12/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-decrypt-20250512.json.sig s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-05-12/
```
secbot: evidence-collector: progress 2/4 (SEC-1029, commit/d9f7a2 added).
eng-zoe: Kube audit shows the RoleBinding creation correlated at 2025-05-12T14:19:58Z and the deploy CI at 14:20:05Z. I'll add a timeline to the one-pager.
auditor_lee: Also provide retention statement and immutability: we need confirmation logs are retained 13 months and stored with write-once snapshots for at least 7 days.
paul_sec: Retention: policy logs-retention-policy-v2 = 395 days. Evidence bucket retains immutable snapshots (WORM) for 7 days before lifecycle. I'll cite internal policy doc link.
ops-ryan: Uploaded signed export to s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-05-12/kms-decrypt-20250512.json (sig present). SHA256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855 (notarized).
secbot: evidence-collector: progress 4/4. job ev-20250512-014 status=success artifacts=4
auditor_lee: Perfect. Please send the presigned bundle + one-page control map (showing SEC-1029 -> CC-3.2, CC-6.1, ISO A.9.4). Auditor might request 5 random raw lines for forensic hash verification.
sasha: I'll assemble the one-pager and upload bundle. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
